DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease (Distal Obstruction). 

The normal blood work and electrolytes rule out systemic infection or metabolic causes, while the X-ray findings of dilated bowel with no gas in the rectum confirm a distal blockage. Given the age of 8 months and the chronic feeding difficulties, this is the most likely cause. I will proceed with a contrast enema to visualize the transition zone.
